purpose: Teach: 念仏/党派/連隊/中退/白血病/リンパ/邁進/衰弱

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者が念仏を唱えていたことを警察、確認されましたね
lines.en: The police have confirmed the suspect was chanting nenbutsu during the incident, haven't they?
lines.style: Measured, observational tone. Leaning forward slightly with intellectual curiosity. Phrasing as gentle inquiry rather than accusation. Pace is steady, unhurried.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、特定の党派に偏らず捜査します
lines.en: The police conduct their investigation without bias toward any particular faction.
lines.style: Formal but not cold. Clear enunciation on key phrases. Even breathing, professional cadence. A statement of principle, delivered with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、機動連隊との連携を強化されてますね
lines.en: The police are strengthening coordination with the mobile units in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Genuine interest in the operational details. Soft upturn at the end — inviting confirmation rather than challenging. Attentive silence between phrases.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、中退者の社会復帰を支援する活動も続けます
lines.en: The police will continue supporting the social reintegration of former dropouts.
lines.style: Steady, reassuring tone. Slight warmth underneath the formality — this matters beyond procedure. Deliberate pacing, like explaining something important to someone who needs to hear it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者が白血病を患った経緯を警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: The police have grasped the circumstances of how the victim contracted leukemia, haven't they?
lines.style: Quieter, more careful. Genuine concern beneath the formal phrasing. Slower pace on the medical detail. Respectful acknowledgment of the victim's suffering.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者のリンパ節の医学的検査を依頼します
lines.en: The police will request a medical examination of the victim's lymph nodes.
lines.style: Professional, clinical but not detached. Even tempo. Slight pause before the technical term to ensure clarity. Factual without being cold.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、市民の信頼回復に邁進されてますね
lines.en: The police are making earnest efforts to restore public trust in this case, aren't they?
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Slower, more deliberate pace. Warmth in the tone — recognizing the weight of that responsibility. Trailing slightly upward with genuine respect.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、衰弱した被害者の救護を最優先します
lines.en: The police will prioritize the rescue and care of the weakened victim above all else.
lines.style: Firm resolve. Emphasis on 「最優先」with quiet intensity. Measured but not hesitant — this is non-negotiable. Steady eye-contact level, grounded posture in the voice.
